name: jira
description: Ticket ops (get, comment, close, label, search, create) mapped to the Atlassian remote MCP server

facts.name: JIRA_SITE
facts.meaning: Atlassian site host, used to pick the cloudId
facts.ask: What is your Jira site address (for example example.atlassian.net)?

facts.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
facts.meaning: Jira project that tickets are searched and created in; in Jira this equals TICKET_PREFIX
facts.ask: What is the Jira project key (the part before the dash in ABC-123)?

owner_tasks.task: Authorize the Atlassian MCP server: run /mcp in Claude Code, pick atlassian and sign in
owner_tasks.why: every ticket op goes through it; it uses OAuth, so there is no token to store

owner_tasks.task: Create the open-items tracker ticket (the OPEN_ITEMS_TICKET fact) in Jira if it doesn't exist yet, or ask the agent to create it
owner_tasks.why: noted findings are filed there; a missing ticket makes every filing fail
